source: ... Lange nicht gesehen, Rover. Lass uns von nun an aufeinander aufpassen.
target: ……好久不见，漂泊者。接下来的这段时间里，我们互相照顾吧。

source: ... Pourquoi est-ce ici ? Somnoire, Métropole de la Faille Temporelle... Combien de fois l'avez-vous déjà rencontré ?
target: ……它怎么会出现在这里？心之集域、时隙废都……这已经是你第几次见到它了？

source: ... Warum ist es hier? Somnoire, Stadt im Zeitriss ... Wie oft bist du ihm schon begegnet?
target: ……它怎么会出现在这里？心之集域、时隙废都……这已经是你第几次见到它了？

source: ... 결국, 아무것도 없는 해저에서 이 기묘한 멜로디만이 울리고 있다. 이건 그 영원히 올 수 없는, 그들이 약속했던 새로운 세계의 제1악장에 속한다
target: ……最终，只剩下这奇异的旋律在空无一物的海底回响。这是属于那个永远都无法到来的，祂们承诺过的新世界的第一乐章。

source: ... 오랜만이에요, 방랑자. 앞으로도 잘 부탁드릴게요
target: ……好久不见，漂泊者。接下来的这段时间里，我们互相照顾吧。

source: ... 이게 왜 여기에 있지? 마음의 영역, 시간의 폐허... 이번에는 벌써 몇 번째 보는 것일까?
target: ……它怎么会出现在这里？心之集域、时隙废都……这已经是你第几次见到它了？

source: ......結局、この奇妙な旋律だけが、何もない海の底で響き渡っている。それは決して辿り着くことのない、約束された新世界の第一楽章だった。
target: ……最终，只剩下这奇异的旋律在空无一物的海底回响。这是属于那个永远都无法到来的，祂们承诺过的新世界的第一乐章。

source: ...Long time no see, Rover. For the days to come, let's look out for each other.
target: ……好久不见，漂泊者。接下来的这段时间里，我们互相照顾吧。

source: A captured fragment of a Tacet Return Wave, as silent as a broken string. Unravel it, and the Tacetite Bloom contained within will awaken in your hand, offering its soundless gift.
target: 一缕被截取的无音回波，如断弦般静默。启封此物，其内所携的黑石花将重现掌心，为你带来静默的馈赠。

source: A card issued by Jianji to the donors, which can be presented to Jianji to claim dividends.
target: 简集发放给捐赠者的硬质卡片,可凭此在简集处领取分红。

source: A cartridge preserving memories of the good old days, alongside the final chapter of a true legend's journey.
target: 储存着某人经历的卡带。它记录着昔日的美好，回不去的过往，和一段传奇的落幕。

source: A celebratory cake from the Spacetrek Collective. Don't worry—it's 100% free of food security issues.
target: 深空联合出品的生日蛋糕，绝对不会有任何食品安全问题。

source: A challenge proof required to get the Seaside Arena ticket.
target: 获取海场角斗门票所需的挑战证明。

source: A chart worth "a whole coin," carrying a hidden story, a big adventure, and... a person's untold life.
target: 价值「一枚硬币」的海图，代表了一段故事、一次冒险和一个人的一生。

source: A cherished item among the Rinascita people, it is said to hold music within, crafted by skilled artisans. However, due to internal damage, it no longer fulfills its original purpose.
target: 黎那汐塔人钟爱的一种收藏品，据说心灵手巧的黎那汐塔匠人用工艺的方式铭刻了音乐。由于内部结构已经损坏，不再具备原本的效用。

source: A cherry blossom bonsai made by Chisa.
target: 由千咲制作的樱花盆景

source: A cherry blossom bonsai made by Chisa. She handpicked the branches from Sakura Quarter, where you two roamed together.
target: 由千咲制作的樱花盆景，樱花花枝来自你们曾一同散步的樱漫町。

source: A chip found in the Dim Forest. Seems to be the survey record of a botanist.
target: 在无光之森发现的芯片，似乎是某位植物学家的考察记录。

source: A chip that can release pulse vortex.
target: 装载后能释放脉冲涡流的芯片。

source: A chip with missing content. Therefore, it cannot be directly used to optimize the performance of Echoes. However, by collecting enough quantity of these chips, you can still pick out complete frequencies with similar effects.
target: 内容有缺失的芯片，无法直接用于调优声骸。但如果能收集足够的数量，也可以筛选出效果接近的完整频率集。

source: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a breathtakingly stable equilibrium. As a critical material for advanced technologies, it is subject to the strictest trade restrictions worldwide.
target: 呈现切削晶块结构的海蚀遗留物，具备令人叹为观止的平衡态。由于该物质是许多高精尖领域的必需品，当今世界对其采取了最严格的贸易限制政策。

source: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a delicate equilibrium and, after centrifugation, its concentrated product becomes widely useful.
target: 呈现切削晶块结构的海蚀遗留物，保持着微妙的平衡态。其经过离心机高度浓缩后的产物拥有广泛用途。

source: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It remains stable and, with the proper absorber, the contained Remnant Energy may still be extracted.
target: 呈现切削晶块结构的海蚀遗留物，尚未处于衰退态。如果选择合适的吸收剂，或许还能从中提取回音能量。

source: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. Originally a blocky structure, its equilibrium is broken, and its Remnant Energy has mostly dissipated.
target: 呈现切削晶块结构的海蚀遗留物，然而其维持的平衡态已被打破，所蕴藏的回音已从断面流失殆尽。

source: A chrysanthemum-shaped crystal found within jade. Elegant and unfurling, it is hailed as the "ethereal one among the stones."
target: 玉石中的菊花形伴生晶体，清雅舒展，被誉为“石中清客”。

source: A clear and sparkling star that shines just like the North Star in Pegasus.
target: 一颗晶莹剔透的星星，就像《珀伽索斯》里的北极星一样闪耀。

source: A clearance module specially authorized by Carlotta, granting you full access to every section of Averardo Vault.
target: 由珂莱塔特别授权给漂泊者的权限组件，可让你在埃弗拉德金库内畅行无阻。

source: A coin frequency found at Forever Fest. Can be exchanged for decorations from Cobb Copo.
target: 从无尽宴会中找到的硬币频率，可用于在柯布·科波处交换陈设。

source:
A collection of raw test objects (cached, unnormalized, with comments still present). Analysis yields non-deterministic results.
"Wait, this is new to me... Hey, what're you doing to my surprise?!"
target:
缓存、待删除注释以及未正式化的测试内容集合体，通过解析可以获得难辨真假的情报。
“不是，这内容我都没见过……不要啊，本王的惊喜！”

source: A combo featuring ham, roasted poultry, and grilled steaks—a true blessing for meat lovers. For Septimontian Gladiators, a post-battle celebration is all about devouring vast quantities of roasted meat.
target: 以火腿、烤禽肉和烤肉排为主的套餐，肉食爱好者毋庸置疑的福音。对于七丘的角斗士来说，战斗之后的庆典就是抱着各种各样的烤肉大快朵颐的过程。

source: A commemorative photo from Shixia.
target: 试夏赠予的纪念留影。

source: A commemorative photo from the Pioneer Association. Can be enlarged to view the details.
target: 先行公约赠送的赛事纪念照片，可放大查阅。

source: A commemorative photo of the sunrise viewed from the top of Mt. Pingting.
target: 登顶屏庭山观看日出时的纪念留影。

source: A commemorative photo of the sunrise viewed from the top of Mt. Pingting. This ray of morning sun inspires people to firmly run towards the ideal tomorrow.
target: 登顶屏庭山观看日出时的纪念留影。这一缕朝阳鼓舞着攀上高峰的人们坚定地奔向理想的明天。

source: A commemorative photo of you and Jiyan in the relay race.
target: 你与忌炎在接力赛的纪念照片。

source: A common Ragunna-style lamp that can be found in many places there.
target: 拉古那常见款式的台灯，在很多地方都能见到。

source: A common Ragunna-style table-and-chair set, constructed from joined wooden planks.
target: 拉古那常见的桌椅套装，使用木板拼接而成。

source: A common card, sprayed with the Exiles' favorite color, is an important access card to the Exiles camp.
target: 一张普通的卡片，喷涂上流放者喜欢的颜色，是进入流放者营地的重要出入证。

source: A common fruit known for being sweet, juicy, and pleasantly fragrant.
target: 常见的水果，甘甜多汁，香气宜人。

target: 拉古那常见的落地灯。其上充当烛台的触肢其实是某种构造简单的声骸，时不时还会轻轻蠕动。

source: A common plucked string instrument from Rinascita. Boasting ancient origins, it remains a signature tool for wandering bards.
target: 黎那汐塔常见的拨弦乐器，其起源相当古老，是吟游诗人的代表性乐器之一。

source: A common polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The spiral structure is fairly complete. Seems to be an analog circuit recording the behavioral patterns of a Tacet Discord.
target: 常见的方形声核结构，形状复杂有序，呈现为完整的立方螺旋，仿若勾勒了残象行为模式的回路。

source: A common purple flower from the Septimont plains. Locals use it for spice blends or as home décor.
target: 于七丘平原生长的紫色花种。这种紫色的花随处可见，七丘人常用其制作香料，也常将其插放到家中的花瓶中。

source: A common souvenir of the Moon-Chasing Festival that can be exchanged for exclusive rewards.
target: 追月节常见的纪念品，用于兑换活动奖励。

source: A common thickening ingredient often used as a substitute for water in cooking to enrich the texture.
target: 常见的辅助原料，常在烹饪时作为水的替代，加入到菜肴或汤羹中，使味道更浓郁。

source: A common vegetable, occasionally carved into lanterns during certain festivals.
target: 常见的蔬菜，在某些庆典中，它们有时候会被雕刻成灯笼。

source: A common water purifier, designed as a standard device to ensure the safety of drinking water.
target: 随处可见的净水机，用于保障饮用水安全的典型装置。

source: A communicator given to you by Lucilla. Designed in her personal style, this device is well-suited for covert operations.
target: 洛瑟菈交予你的通讯器，该装置按照她个人的风格设计，具有较好的隐蔽性。

source: A communicator given to you by Lucilla. It resembles a makeup mirror.
target: 洛瑟菈交予你的通讯器，外观与化妆镜相似。

source: A compact magnetic chip encoded with flight data and combat routines. Used to grant EXP to Persona Pinballs.
target: 记录着航行数据与战斗回路的小磁片，可用于提升人格弹珠的经验。

source: A component that requires a large amount of computing power to run. It can stably output power, and when loaded on a Terminal, it can significantly improve the owner's mobility.
target: 需要大量算力才能运行的元件，其能够稳定地输出动力，装载在终端上后可以显著提高所有者的运动能力。

source: A concha rochosa que cobre o braço do Beringal-feiliano, batizada em homenagem ao rugido estrondoso do seu soco pesado.
target: 覆盖在飞廉之猩臂膊上的岩壳，因飞廉的重拳挥落之际的千钧呼啸而得名。

source: A condiment dubbed as the king of all condiments that brings the taste that's indispensable for every dish.

source: A confection Yanshu asked you to give to Jingran.
target: 烟舒拜托你转交的糕点。

source: A confection Yanshu asked you to give to Jingran. Seems to be fresh out of the oven.
target: 烟舒拜托你转交给景燃的糕点，似乎是刚刚才做好的。

source: A confession letter Jiuwu wrote to Sonija, attached with several drafts.
target: 久梧写给索尼娅的自白信，包括几张草稿。

source: A confession letter to Sonija, bearing the marks of countless erasures and revisions. The final draft was never sent out due to a lack of determination.
target: 写给索尼娅的自白信，经过多次涂抹、删改方才写成，或因缺少决心，成稿并未送出。

source: A copper mirror given by Buling.
target: 卜灵交给你的铜镜。

source: A coward's heart seeks refuge in the shell of bravery.
target: 怯懦的心更爱寄居在英勇的躯壳中。

source: A crafted collection of recorded music, which, when given to the Aria Mummer, adds the tracks to their collection list.

target: 红茶和冰茶相结合的创新茶饮，两种原本截然不同的茶叶混合，创造出了新的香气与口感。

source: A creative blend of coffee and bitter melon juice. Overwhelmingly bitter, almost no other flavor can be tasted.
target: 在咖啡中加入苦瓜汁制成的创新饮品，除了难以言喻的苦味之外几乎尝不出别的味道。

source: A crown that casts countless rays of starlight.
target: 留有万数星彩的冠冕。

source: A crude ring that serves more as an identification than for practical use. It is used to display one's commitment to sever ties with civilized society.
target: 材质简陋的镣环，比起实用价值，更多是充当身份证明，用于标榜自己与文明社会彻底决裂的态度。

source: A crude voice material made by the Exiles.
target: 流放者自制的土法声料。

source: A cup in the likeness of Namipon. Well-received and designed for cuteness.
target: 波仔样式的水杯，造型可爱，广受好评。

source:
A cup of seemingly ordinary shaved ice. Is it really as ordinary as it looks?
...Alright, yes. It is absolutely ordinary. But for Septimontians, this simple treat is one of the few chances to truly cool down.
target:
一杯看上去平平无奇的刨冰，真的平平无奇吗？
……不用怀疑，这就是一杯平平无奇的刨冰。不过，品尝刨冰的时候，是七丘人难得的冷静时刻。

source: A cup showing Namipon in fashionable threads, brought to you in collaboration with a well-known project.
target: 和某人气企划进行联名推出的波仔水杯。水杯上的波仔带着新潮装饰。

source: A research report on "Sugar Pearl" and "Tacet Discord Outbreak", placed on the "Wei" Shelf of Huaxu Academy's archives.
target: 存放在今州华胥研究院档案室的档案资料，「未」字列，一份关于「糖丸」和「残象潮战役」的研究报告。

source: A research report on Jinzhou's first Resonator, placed on the "Wei" Shelf of Huaxu Academy's archives.
target: 存放在今州华胥研究院档案室的档案资料，「未」字列，今州第一份共鸣者报告。

source: A residual fragment of Phrolova's Forte. Though not nearly as strong as her baton, it remains just sufficient for Orchestrating.
target: 弗洛洛共鸣能力的残留物，虽无法比拟指挥棒中的能量，但也能勉强发挥调律的作用。

source: A residual fragment of Phrolova's Forte. Though not nearly as strong as the baton, it remains just sufficient for Orchestrating.
target: 弗洛洛共鸣能力的残留物，虽无法比拟指挥棒中的能量，但也能勉强发挥调律的作用。

source: A respiração da fenda traz paz e calma...
target: 裂隙中传出的气息让人安心……

source: A restored wooden plaque with mysterious carvings. You remember seeing a socket where it could fit somewhere before…
target: 将两块木牌拼合成完整的木牌，篆刻的纹样依旧不可辨认，似乎在哪里见过可以放置这块木牌的凹槽？

source: A reward for restoring the Voidbane Eldertrees. Deliver it to I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp to raise your Base Camp Level.
target: 培育虚蚀古代乔木后获得的自然馈赠，交付至勘探基地的I.R.I.S.可提升基地等级。

source: A reward for taking part in Resonance Sim Realm simulations. Can be exchanged for supplies.
target: 参与「群声共振模拟域」模拟的奖励，可用于兑换物资。

source: A reward voucher from Lollo Logistics, issued to party supporters. Can be exchanged for generous rewards provided by Lollo Logistics.
target: 呜呜物流赠送给派对协助者的兑换卡，能够兑换呜呜物流提供的丰厚奖励。

source: A rica experiência ajuda a se adaptar às regras de sobrevivência deste mundo.
target: 丰富的经验有助于适应这个世界的生存法则。

source:
A rocking pirate ship. In the movie, tossing it into the sea starts a thrilling adventure.
A rumor later debunked by Namipon.
target:
不停摇摆的海盗船，电影中把它扔到真正的大海上就可以开始一场冒险。
经波仔查证系谣传。

source: A round, pearl-shaped candy ball hidden inside a simple sweet wrapper.
target: 似乎是一颗糖果，小巧圆润，形同真珠。 包装十分审慎而朴素。

source: A rune Sigrika carved for you.
target: 西格莉卡为你刻印下的符文。

source: A sacred aura lingers, as if a quiet sigh was left behind by someone.
target: 其中还存有些许圣洁的气韵，似是某人留下的一声小小的叹息。

source: A salvaged vinyl record. The surface has been meticulously cleaned, yet the scars of time remain plainly visible.
target: 原本是唱片制品的废弃物，即便已被重新擦拭，仍能看出时间留下的磨损。

source: A sample of potential new site locations. It is used to test whether the environment meets the standards for site construction.
target: 新站点备选位置的样本，用于检测该地的环境是否达到建造站点的标准。

source: A scrap of paper retrieved from a fallen Gladiator.
target: 于阵亡角斗士身上回收的纸条。

source: A screenshot of a chat with Lucilla. It may be the key to reaching the rendezvous point.
target: 与洛瑟菈的聊天截图，或许可以成为通向会合点的钥匙。

source: A script from Phrolova.
target: 弗洛洛交予你的剧本。

source: A scripture fragment found on the seabed of the Riccioli Islands, documenting what is unrecorded in the Codex of the Order of the Deep. Those fragmentary words seem to respond to the very call of the ocean.
target: 在黎乔利群岛海底发现的断章，记录着隐海修会正典中全无记载的经文。只言片语的残片，仿佛响应着大海的呼唤。

source: A scripture fragment obtained by chance, used to enhance Phoebe's Fishing Ability, add Request slots, and lower Request consumption.
target: 偶然获得的经文断章，可以提升菲比的捕捞技巧，增加委托栏位并降低委托消耗。

source: A scripture fragment obtained by chance, used to enhance Phoebe's Fishing Ability, and increase hull Durability.
target: 偶然获得的经文断章，可以提升菲比的捕捞技巧，增加船体耐久度。

source: A scripture fragment obtained by chance, used to enhance Phoebe's Fishing Ability, and increase the probability of obtaining Mutants.
target: 偶然获得的经文断章，可以提升菲比的捕捞技巧，增加获得异变鱼的概率。

source: A scripture fragment obtained by chance, used to enhance Phoebe's Fishing Ability.
target: 偶然获得的经文断章，用于提升菲比的捕捞技巧。

source: A scroll painting that Zhezhi gave you. The beautiful scenery depicted in the painting seems to give off a different feeling than before.
target: 折枝赠予你的画卷，画中美景似乎蕴含着不同于以往的心意。

source: A scroll painting that Zhezhi gave you. This is the first scroll painting she has painted with her Forte in many years. The beautiful scenery depicted in the painting seems to give off a different feeling than before.
target: 折枝赠予你的画卷。这是她多年后重新用共鸣能力画出的第一幅画，画中美景似乎蕴含着不同于以往的心意。

source: A sea-weathered journal of Ahab's past sailing experiences.
target: 饱经海风洗练的日记本，记录着亚哈过去航海时的经历。

source: A secret edition capsule that holds a Namipon in an all-new dance pose.
target: 隐藏款的波仔扭蛋，波仔以全新的姿势起舞。

source:
A seemingly ordinary feather, soft and warm to the touch.

A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams."
target:
一枚看似寻常的羽毛。细腻而温暖。
于活动事件【当你凝视梦渊时】中完成所有挑战的证明。

source: A segunda música de fundo tocada durante o confronto com o Dragão da Lamentação. A Caixa de Melodia desta faixa é obtida do Baú de Suprimentos no lustre do Depósito Eco da Câmara de Averardo.
target: 与叹息古龙对决时的背景音乐其二，在埃弗拉德金库的声骸藏馆吊灯上的奇藏中获得该乐曲的鸣奏之匣。

source: A semente da Árvore Cloudperch. Suas brácteas opostas se abrem amplamente, assemelhando-se a um par de asas pousadas sobre um ramo.
target: 风栖桐的种子，其苞片对生舒展，犹如栖停在枝头的一对羽翼。

source: A shard of mirror showing the reflection of the White Cat. But on which side of the mirror does reality lie? Glancing into it feels like delving into a dream.
target: 一块残缺的镜片，倒映着白猫的影子，镜片的两面究竟谁是真，谁是假？就如同踏入梦境一般。

source: A shard of mirror showing the reflection of the White Cat. Used to unlock Dream Boon.
target: 倒影着白猫影子的镜片，可凭此解锁梦境演变。

source:
A shattered piece of an Anchor Stone, still emitting the force field as ever.
"Let this small thing pry open the cracks in fate's door."
target: 一小块破碎的定向锚，仍不竭地释放着恒常而不可侵的力场。“就让这枚小东西为我们撬开命运之门的裂隙。”

source: A shattered piece of an Anchor Stone.
target: 破碎的定向锚之一片。

source: A shattered piece of an Anchor Stone. The False Sovereign must be made to take this in by all means.
target: 破碎的定向锚之一片。请务必设法将其送至伪作的神王的体内。

source: A sheet music book gifted by Ciaccona, preserving every melody she recorded on her travels.
target: 夏空赠予你的乐谱本，上面记录着她过往旅行时记录的旋律。

source: A sheet music book gifted by Ciaccona, preserving every melody she recorded on her travels. With her Forte, she can bring the stories behind the music back to life.
target: 夏空赠予你的乐谱本，上面记录着她过往旅行时记录的旋律。夏空通过共鸣能力能将旋律背后承载的故事复现出来。

source: A ship of the Order Tribunal, often found cruising the sea. It always arrives in time to "mediate" conflicts. They may have "absolved" the guilty, but others never "absolve" them.
target: 巡游在大海上的赦免院船只，总能及时赶到冲突处给予“调停”。也许他“赦免”了有罪者，但很明显有些人不会放过他。

source: A ship, wrecked in the struggle for its seal. Treachery set its sail ablaze, toppled its masts, and left nothing but this seal.
target: 因争夺印章而坠毁的船只，阴谋诡计将船帆点燃，桅杆推倒，到最后只剩印章。

source: A simple cold dish of pulled chicken with an appetizing splash of hot chili oil. Although simple to make, it always reminds people of their childhood.
target: 简简单单的凉拌手撕鸡，加入烫好的红油提香。虽做法简单，但总能让人想到小时候的味道。

source: A simulated material composed of Remnant data, used to level up Combat Machines in "Tidal Defense Simulator."
target: 由回音数据组成的模拟材料，用于在「潮蚀模拟」活动中升级作战装置。

source: A sketch drawn with a naive stroke, pressed between faded leaves of a damaged diary. It portrays a family of four and separate image on each one.
target: 夹在一本破旧日记本中的简笔画，笔触相当稚嫩，能够看出上面画着四个人的家庭，似乎是日记的主人在小时候对家人的印象。

source: A sketch that appears faded due to age. It constitutes a past memory and a treasure to a child.
target: 看上去很破旧的简笔画，记载了一段记忆、一段过往，一份孩童的宝藏。

source: A sleek screen of modern design. The Montelli Family has a deep affinity for this artistic movement and maintains an extensive collection of similar works within their Vault.
target: 现代风的简约屏风。莫塔里家族对以此为代表的艺术风格很感兴趣，因此在金库中收藏了许多类似的装饰品。

source: A small KU-Roro plushie. The robot wears a dead-eyed look... Not great for the Black Shores' public image!
target: 小型库洛洛玩偶。机器人脸上露出了死鱼眼的表情……有损黑海岸企业形象！

source: A small camera that is convenient to carry around. Photos captured by it have a unique vibe.
target: 可以随身携带的小型相机，拍出来的照片有种独特质感。

source: A small gift from a child. She hopes you enjoy a sweet time in Jinzhou.
target: 「希望你能在这里甜甜的，今州的客人！」一个来自小孩子的小小礼物。

source: A small knife given by Mr. Zi.
target: 从兹先生那里得到的小刀。

source: A small token resembling ancient currency. Can be used to exchange for supplies at the Yard Exchange.
target: 外表类似钱币的小型令牌，可在「井栈易物」中兑换物资。

source: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.
target: 一张精致小巧的配比数据卡，其中的数据被合成台读取后即可获得合成对应产品的权限。

source: A small, decorative Ragunna-style lamp, frequently used to adorn gardens.
target: 拉古那风格的小型装饰灯，常被用于装点庭院。

source: A smaller fragment of a wooden plaque with mysterious carvings, possibly used in ancient rituals. The meaning of the patterns is unknown.
target: 一小块残缺的木牌，牌面上篆刻了奇怪的木纹，无法辨认内容，似乎是某种古老仪式的祈愿牌。

source: A soft pink flowerbed that evokes the beauty of dreamy, fleeting moments.
target: 淡粉色的花圃，令人联想起如梦似幻的时光。

source: A softly contoured talisman with a lustrous finish, engraved with Royan patterns.
target: 线条柔和质感莹润的护身符，雕刻着罗伊族的图案。

source:
A solid solvent made using a special process that imparts healing effects.
Allegedly invented by someone after going to Rinascita. Apparently, they really wanted to become a Master Echo Trainer.
target:
使用特殊工艺制造的固体溶剂，具有复合效果。
据说其是一位梦想成为声骸训练大师的人到达黎那汐塔区域后的新发明。

source: A song kept on an old phonograph record gifted by Lianna.
target: 莉亚娜赠予的老唱片中的歌曲。

source: A song kept on an old phonograph record gifted by Lianna. Unlocked after completing Side Quest "Moments Captured in Light."
target: 莉亚娜赠予的老唱片中的歌曲，完成纪闻任务「被光影定格的瞬间」后解锁。

source: A song once popular in the Land of Xuanfang.
target: 曾在玄方地界广为传唱的一首歌谣。

source: A song once popular in the Land of Xuanfang. Defeat Thousand-Puppet Pavilion in Main Quest "Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled" to unlock.
target: 曾在玄方地界广为传唱的一首歌谣，在潮汐任务「玄翎振壑定澜音」中击败千傀重楼后解锁。

source: A song sung by the Troupe members. Unlocked in the Main Quest "What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing."
target: 剧团的成员们齐唱的歌曲，在潮汐任务「昔我悲伤，今却歌唱」中解锁。

source: A sorte também é poder.
target: 运气也是实力的一种

source: A souvenir badge for travelers in Septimont. Can be used to advance reward progress in Gifts of Glory.
target: 勋章形制的七丘旅行纪念徽章，可凭此在荣光赠礼中积攒进度。

source: A special Coast Flax native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a roughing material.
target: 黎乔利群岛特产的滨海亚麻，非常常见的粗加工材料。

source: A special Coast Flax native to the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to enhance Fishing Abilities.
target: 黎乔利群岛特产的滨海亚麻，可以用来升级捕鱼科技。

source: A special Palm Tree Log native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a roughing material.
target: 黎乔利群岛特产的棕榈原木，非常常见的粗加工材料。

source: A special Palm Tree Log native to the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to enhance Fishing Abilities.
target: 黎乔利群岛特产的棕榈原木，可以用来升级捕鱼科技。

source: A special coupon prepared by KU-Uigon for Black Shores staff participating in "Tidal Defense Simulator." Can be used to redeem rewards during the event.
target: 库伊贡为参与「潮蚀模拟」的黑海岸人员所准备的兑换券，可用于在「潮蚀模拟」活动中换取奖励。

source: A special firecracker made by following a secret blueprint found in Xisha. Refrain from using this in crowded areas as it is both powerful and loud.
target: 使用西沙所找到的秘方所制造的特殊鞭炮。威力强劲，声音洪亮，请务必在远离人群的地方燃放。

source: A special item obtained after fully restoring the Plushie Village.
target: 完全修复布偶村后获得的纪念道具。

source: A special material from the Bell-Borne Geochelone.
target: 从鸣钟之龟身上获得的特殊素材。

source: A special material. A reward will be granted after you've gathered a certain number of them.
target: 一种特别的物质，收集一定数量后可以获得奖励。

source: A special product that combines potions of different potencies, which may provide a variety of unexpected benefits.
target: 将不同功效的合剂联装后制成的特殊产品，能够提供各种意想不到的增益效果。

source: A special reward obtained from the "Full Throttle! Bolt & Blitz!" event.
target: 在活动「奔驰！箭速与激情！」中获得的特殊奖励。

source: A special reward obtained from the "Stranger Things in Honami" event.
target: 在活动「穗波怪异物语」中获得的特殊奖励。

source: A special reward obtained from the "Tidal Defense Simulator" event. It records the highest TD waves you withstood in the "Total Defense Test."
target: 在活动「潮蚀模拟」中获得的特殊奖励，记录着在「全局防卫测试」挑战中成功抵御的最高残象波次。

source: A special reward obtained in "Virtual Crisis: Frontier Trials." It records the highest total Stress Level reached during the challenge.
target: 在「虚域危局·维度超验」中所获得的特殊奖励，记录着曾在挑战中达成的最高总负荷等级。

source: A special reward obtained in "Virtual Crisis: Prototype Trials." It records the highest total Stress Level reached during the challenge.
target: 在「虚域危局·原型解算」中所获得的特殊奖励，记录着曾在挑战中达成的最高总负荷等级。

source: A special reward obtained in "Virtual Crisis: Quadrant Trials." It records the highest total Stress Level reached during the challenge.
target: 在「虚域危局·象限延展」中所获得的特殊奖励，记录着曾在挑战中达成的最高总负荷等级。

source: A special species of Gulpuff. Can be used as explosives, thus they are known as "Bampuffs."
target: 一种特殊的咕咕河豚，似乎可以用来当做炸弹使用，因而又被称为“砰砰河豚”。

source: A special species of Gulpuff. Can be used as explosives.
target: 一种特殊的咕咕河豚，似乎可以用来当做炸弹使用。

source: A special supply chest. Its exterior is made from high-performance materials designed to withstand extreme heat and pressure.
target: 特质的补给箱，其外壳使用了耐高温高压的材质，能够有效保护其中装载的物资。

source: A special voucher issued across Solaris, valued at 300 Lunites per voucher for outfit purchases.
target: 索拉里斯通用的消费礼券，使用一张礼券购买服饰时可抵消300月相。

source: A special-shaped key that can open the secret passage in the Dim Forest. It belongs to the zookeeper before the Lament.
target: 能够开启无光之森秘密通道的特殊形状的钥匙，是悲鸣前动物园管理人员的所有物。

source: A specialty bamboo shoot from the Land of Xuanfang. Shaped like the coiled horns of a mythical beast, it is exceptionally delicious.
target: 玄方地界特产的青云笋，形似异兽蟠曲的长角，十分美味。

source: A specialty mineral with a shape of needle clusters. Sharp and tough. Mostly used in cutting metals or other crystals or making weapons.
target: 针簇状的特色矿物，质地锋利而坚硬。红针晶簇的造物常用于切割金属与其它晶体，或用作武器的生产。

source: A specialty snack from Homani City, which can be exchanged for items or used to upgrade Cafe Decor.
target: 穗波的特产点心，可以用来兑换道具或升级列车长咖啡厅装潢。

source: A specialty snack from Homani City, widely praised for its soft, chewy texture and sweet, fragrant filling. Namipon's favorite. Deliver these to Namipon in exchange for items or use them to upgrade Cafe Decor.
target: 穗波市的特产点心，因软糯口感和内藏的香甜馅料而广受好评。波仔最喜欢的食物，交给波仔可以用来兑换道具，或是升级列车长咖啡厅的装潢。

source:
A species of scarab that resembles a coin in appearance, with a reflective golden exoskeleton.
For Golden Thiefbats, Goldcrest Scarabs are both a pleasant sight and a delicious snack.
target:
酷似钱币的金龟子，背甲反射着亮闪闪的金属色泽。
对于星币伏翼来说，盾金龟堪称视觉与味觉上的双重享受。

source: A spirit bird whose cry heralds the dawn; a morning star that lights the dark night.
target: 啼破黎明的灵鸟，照亮玄夜的晓星。

source: A stack of barrels filled with aging vintages. Many in Rinascita believe that the longer a vintage rests in oak, the better its flavor becomes.
target: 装有陈酿的木桶堆。许多黎那汐塔人都认为，在木桶中存放的时间越久，陈酿的味道就越好。

source: A stack of old, candid photos, most worn beyond recognition.
target: 一叠被抓拍下的老照片，大部分画面已因磨损而毁坏。

source: A stand-up card made by Chisa that conveys Chisa's special feelings.
target: 千咲亲手制作的立体贺卡，附带了特别的心意。

source: A stand-up card that conveys Chisa's special feelings, which she crafted herself while convalescing at the Black Shores. Zoom in for a closer look.
target: 千咲在黑海岸休养期间亲手制作的立体贺卡，附带着她特别的心意，可放大查看。

source: A standard kernel structure produced in massive quantities. This is the most ubiquitous model, serving as the default powerhouse for standard Autopuppets. Commonly found across a wide variety of models.
target: 常见的枢芯结构，是产量最大、正常机傀最常搭载的枢芯。常能在各式机傀身上找到。

source: A standard medication prescribed by the Retreat Ward for basic medical care and injury recovery.
target: 一份来自静护阁的药品，常用于处理伤病。

source: A standardized Terminal for the Spacetrek Collective members. Your Rabelle Cassette is stored within.
target: 深空联合成员配备的标准化终端，你的「拉贝尔磁带」已被置于其中。

source: A stew comprised of mixed protein and vegetables. The popular Jinzhou family meal allows for the preservation of the ingredients' natural flavors to the maximum owing to its simplicity and versatility. "Jinzhou Stew, Jingzhou brew!"
target: 将肉和蔬菜乱炖而成的菜肴。原料自由、做法简单，最大限度保留了肉菜的原始风味，是今州人民最爱的本帮菜。 “今州烩，今州味！”

source: A stone with carvings of portraits and Royan characters.
target: 刻有图画和罗伊文字的石头。

source: A stored memory of your battles in Peaks of Prestige. Used to increase your level in the event.
target: 内含“荣耀之丘”决斗录像的记忆体，可用于提升“荣耀之丘”玩家的等级。

source: A strange Tacetite Bloom arranged in a spiral pattern. Can be used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Bloodpact's Pledge.
target: 以螺旋状排列的奇异黑石花，可用于提高血誓盟约的谐振等级。

source: A strange book found floating in the Sea of Ghosts... maybe it's the key to a hidden bookcase door. This book cannot be opened, its contents will not be revealed... Perhaps that's for the best.
target:
「幽灵之海」中浮现的奇怪书籍，似乎是开启某个书柜暗门的钥匙。
书本无法打开，里面的内容无法查阅……这可能是件好事。

source: A strange book marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
target: 一本奇怪的书籍，有被海水侵蚀的痕迹。

source: A strange book with a fluid form. It is marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
target: 一本奇怪的书籍，形态不稳定，有被海水侵蚀的痕迹。

source: A strange book, aged and worn. It is marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
target: 一本奇怪的书籍，陈旧而斑驳，有被海水侵蚀的痕迹。

source: A strange data card. It is said that the encryption key stored within can prove the holder has made a financial donation.
target: 看起来有些怪异的数据卡,据说可以通过其储存的秘钥来证明持有者捐赠过一笔款项。

source: A strange diary, filled with childish and broken handwriting. It emanates a strange mix of Resonator and Tacet Discords.
target: 一本奇怪的日记，日记的主人笔触稚嫩。从中可以感受到共鸣者和残象的气息。

source: A strange flower that blooms where the Dark Tide has receded. Though its core has been completely calcified, a faint fragrance still lingers—a proof that life's resilience shall never be underestimated.
target: 黑潮退去之地生出的奇异花朵，被白钙化完全侵蚀的花蕊，虽然褪色却依然留存着某种芬芳——永远不要轻视生命的力量。

source: A strange fruit borne of the Voidbane Eldertree. Can be taken back to the Base Camp for further study.
target: 虚蚀古代乔木产出的奇异果实，可带回基站进行研究。

source:
A strange glowing marine life found in the ocean depths.
The Rinascita legend has it that the Sentinel left the Abyss Luminaries beneath the waves to guide the souls of the drowned.
target:
生长于海底的奇异发光生物。
在黎那汐塔的传说中，岁主将暗渊引灯留在浪潮之下，作为指引那些不幸溺亡于海中灵魂的信标。

source: A strange pact and its accompanying Echo, offered by an unnamed lady. It recreates fragments of the Sentinel's divine miracles in a mysterious way.
target: 不愿透露姓名的女士提供的奇妙契约和配套的声骸眷属，用神秘的方式些微复现了岁主的神迹。

source: A strange-looking key that seems like it can fit into a certain keyhole.
target: 存在异常，如有疑问请联系官方客服

source: A strange-looking key.
target: 长相怪异的钥匙

source: A sturdy awning for the fishing ship, facilitating sea fishing.
target: 渔船使用的船篷，可以提供出海捕捞时的便利。

source: A sturdy, heavy-duty delivery box. If you happen to find one of these boxes abandoned by the roadside, please help recycle it.
target: 物流货件配送箱，耐用结实，如果在野外遇见相似的箱子，请帮忙拾取回收。

source:
A sugar cube supplement made from concentrated precious nutrients. Its active ingredients can be quickly absorbed by the human body.
Sweet and delicious, it's a favorite among children.
target:
将珍贵营养物质浓缩后制成的糖块状补剂，其中的元素能够迅速被人体吸收。
味道香甜可口，孩子都爱吃。

source: A sugary, salty beverage inspired by the favorite tea drink of the miners in Huanglong. During the cold winter months, a bowl of Salted Milk Tea can warm the entire body.
target: 高糖高盐的饮料，由瑝珑矿工钟爱的茶饮发展而来。寒冷的冬天里要是能喝上一碗咸奶茶，全身都会暖融融起来。

source: A sweet Rinascitan-style birthday song performed by the Plushies of the Plushie Village, infused with their warmest wishes just for you!
target: 布偶村的布偶们为你演奏的庆生乐曲，加入了鲜明的黎那汐塔曲风和真诚的祝福。

source: A sweet and sour, bright red sauce that can provide a sweet and sour, rich taste to food.
target: 酸甜适口、色泽红亮的酱汁，可以为食物提供酸酸甜甜的香醇口味。

source: A sweet oral vaccine, reminiscent of candy for children in Jinzhou, symbolizes their triumph over the epidemic.
target: 糖丸模样的口服疫苗制剂，萦绕在孩提舌尖时的甜蜜，成为了一代今州人共克时疫的共同记忆。

source: A swordcraft manual with gentle Sword Energy soaked into it. Despite the passage of many years, only slight wear is evident along its edges. Its keeper must have treasured it greatly.
target: 秘籍周身浸润着温和的剑气，虽历经漫长岁月，外表却只留下了些许磨损的痕迹。看得出来，持有者很珍视它。

source: A symbol of a trusted bond forged with H.E.R.M.E.S. Used to unlock and upgrade various clearance levels in the rider training.
target: 与汉密斯建立信任关系的证明，可用于解锁和升级骑手训练的各项强化权限。

source: A symbol of long-standing mutual trust between Rover and various affiliations. By establishing stable friendships with different affiliations, Rover may gain stronger support in the future.
target: 漂泊者与各个势力之间长久互信的象征，与各个组织形成稳定的友好关系或许能获取更有力的支持。

source: A symbol of triumph and hope, never to falter or fall.
target: 成为旗帜，然后永不倒下。

source:
A symbol of your journey that can be displayed to other wayfarers.
Sigil can be updated in your Profile settings.
target:
见证漂泊者旅途的印章，可展示给其他旅者。
在漂泊者信息中可更换羁旅印章。

source: A table-and-chair set in the Montelli style well suited for business discussions or casual drinks.
target: 莫塔里风格的桌椅套装。很适合在此洽谈业务或稍作小酌。

source: A table-and-chair set in the Septimont style, featuring comfortable sofa-style seating.
target: 七丘风格的桌椅套装，带有相当舒服的沙发椅。

source: A table-and-chair set inspired by Carnevale. In this festive atmosphere, music is a constant—provided by lute players and wandering bards on every corner.
target: 狂欢节主题的桌椅套装。音乐在狂欢节期间必不可少，而手持琉特琴的乐手和吟游诗人更是随处可见。

source: A table-and-chair set inspired by Carnevale. Nectarwine from Egla Town is highly prized in Ragunna, where it is also known as "Gocce di Divino."
target: 狂欢节主题的桌椅套装。埃格拉小镇出产的蜜露果酒在拉古那广受好评，被誉为“生命之水”。

source: A table-and-chair set suitable for midday breaks. It invites you to sink into its soft chairs and bask idly in the sunshine.
target: 适合用于午休的桌椅套装，可以坐在软和的椅子里懒洋洋地晒太阳。

source: A tabletop ornament crafted from various mineral crystals. In many places, these natural wonders are prized as elegant decorative pieces.
target: 使用各种矿石晶体制成的桌面摆件。在许多地方，人们都会将这些美丽的天然造物作为装饰品使用。

source: A taxa de Saque de Itens de Raridade Dourada é aumentada em 15%.
target: 品质颜色为金色的物品出现概率提高15%。

source: A taxa de Saque de Itens de Raridade Roxa ou Dourada é aumentada em 10%.
target: 品质颜色为紫色或金色的物品出现概率提高10%。

source: A tela montada pela Logística Lollo e pela Academia Tochestrela ocasionalmente te lembra de assuntos além da festa.
target: 呜呜物流和星炬学院架设的屏幕，偶尔让你想起派对之外的事。

source: A telescope awaits on the second-floor balcony for stargazing. Be sure to give it a look. (Unlocks at Vibe Level 6)
target: 二楼阳台有一台望远镜，据说，是为了看见星空（聚乐值达到阶段6时解锁）。

source: A temporary Resonance Beacon that can be flexibly placed, it needs to be placed by consuming the core module.
target: 可以灵活放置的临时性信标，需要通过消耗标芯模块进行放置。

source:
A tiny chip that holds an irresistible pull for any Pinball.
"To the far reaches of the galaxy and beyond!"
target: 小小的磁片，对弹珠们而言却有着大大的吸引力。“为了航行到更远的地方——！”

source: A title awarded to master chefs who deserve their place in the hall of fame for both their art and their character.
target: 颁发给在厨艺与厨道均已臻于至境的优秀厨师的称号。

source: A title awarded to those chefs who can already work without instructions. Many only make it here.
target: 给予已经能独当一面的厨师的称号，是很多人一生的顶点。

source: A title awarded to those chefs who mastered the basic cooking skills. Proof of a strider on the long path of cookery.
target: 给予掌握了基础技能的厨师的称号，证明着已经走在了漫长的厨师之路上。

source: A title awarded to those who pick up the kitchen knife and start the journey as a cook. A symbol of every cook's original wish.
target: 授予刚拿起菜刀的厨界新人的称号，是每个厨师的起点与初心。

source: A token earned by submitting exploration reports from various regions. Can be exchanged for "Adventure Packages" during the Beyond the Waves event series.
target: 提交各地区游历见闻后所获得的凭证。凭借该道具即可在“踏潮探历”系列活动中兑换"探历补给"。

source: A token from Cantarella. A beautifully crafted vial adorned with a sapphire that represents the Fisalia family head's authority.
target: 坎特蕾拉交予你的信物，精美的瓶身上镶嵌着代表翡萨烈家主之权的蓝宝石。

source: A token of festival gaiety obtained in Solaris New Voyage Celebration. Can be used to advance reward progress.
target: 索拉新旅庆典上积攒的人气值，可凭此在庆典赠礼中积攒进度。

source: A token of gratitude from the patients of Xuanfang Hold to Baizhi.
target: 玄方城的伤患们赠予白芷的谢礼。

source: A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "Dream Patrol: Ragunna."
target: 于【巡礼之梦·拉古那篇】中完成所有挑战的证明。

source: A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "Dreams of Cindertide: Septimont."
target: 于【烬潮之梦·七丘篇】中完成所有挑战的证明。

source: A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams."
target: 于活动事件【当你凝视梦渊时】中完成所有挑战的证明。

source: A token used by the Constables. Can be used to exchange for supplies at the Yard Exchange.
target: 巡方使所使用的信物，可在「井栈易物」中兑换物资。

source: A touchpad left behind by Athos in the Memento Square.
target: 阿索斯遗落在纪念广场的信息触板。

source: A toy made from unknown materials, capable of detecting weak but warm frequencies.
target: 材质不明的工艺玩具，能感受到纤弱但温暖的频率。

source: A toy made from unknown materials, emanating a faint but warm frequency.
target: 材质不明的工艺玩具，能感受到纤弱但温暖的频率。

source: A track collected in the Forbidden Archive. Unlocked after completing the Exploration Quest "Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm."
target: 在禁书院收集的乐章，完成危行任务「氤柔云海之歌·骤雨之章」后解锁。

source: A tranquil flower, casting its gentle radiance amidst the shadows.
target: 静谧的小花，散发着淡雅的光芒，照亮幽暗。

source: A traveler rides upon the silver shuttle as it drifts across the lake of the heart. The dream stretches on and on, with no end to it.
target: 旅人乘坐于银梭之上，银梭漂浮于心湖之中。梦境如此绵长，看不到尽头。

source: A través de este baile, él vencerá todos los miedos.
target: 以此舞，驱散所有恐惧。

source: A través de las grietas, florece el hielo cristalino...
target: 裂隙中能看见冰凌绽放……

source: A través de las grietas, melodías suaves reverberaban...
target: 裂隙中传出了悠长乐声……

source: A través de las grietas, se oye el retumbar profundo de olas distantes…
target: 裂隙中能听见浪涛滚滚……

source: A través de las grietas, se oyen los profundos rugidos de olas lejanas...
target: 从裂隙中，你听见了巨浪翻涌激荡。

source: A través de las grietas, vislumbraste caer el telón carmesí y fuiste testigo del final de la historia.
target: 从裂隙中，你看见猩红的帷幕落下，故事迎来了终局。

source: A treasure map bearing the location of the Sword of Courage. With the help of the map, one can find the Sword of Courage.
target: 绘制着「勇气之宝剑」所在地的藏宝图。根据这张地图，可以找到「勇气之宝剑」的所在地。

source: A triple-winged metallic shard, exhibiting an unusual radiance. This material forms under extremely rare conditions, and its transformation patterns remain largely unexplored by current scientific research.
target: 形似三重蝶翼的片状金属，表面呈现奇异的光泽。这种物质的形成条件相当苛刻，目前科学界尚未完全了解其转化规律。

source: A true celebration should be full of life! Bring your friends, dive into the fun, and crank up the excitement!
target: 庆典当然是越热闹越好！叫上更多的朋友，体验更多的乐趣，让气氛也再热烈一些！

source: A type of currency issued by Namipon. Can be exchanged for rewards in the "Stranger Things in Honami" event.
target: 波仔推出的一种信用货币，可用来在穗波怪异物语玩法中兑换奖励。

source: A type of strawflower that grows in clusters. Sunflare Everlasting has pinnate leaves and disk-shaped flowers. Once picked and air-dried, the flowers retain their golden hue, described as "sunlight that never fades."
target: 丛生蜡菊，生有羽状叶，花形如同簇状的日冕，风干后仍能保持本色，仿若永不凋零的阳光。

source: A unique formation resembling a tide-breaking vessel, found only on a few powerful Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legend say Tacet Discords bearing this Residuum can chart the course to the Journeying Paradise.
target: 特殊的船状结构造物，如同破浪而行的航船，仅能在黎那汐塔的部分强大残象身上找到。据说跟随着携带此物的残象，能够找到前往「巡游天国」的路途。

source: A unique item that can be used to unlock Scale of Past.
target: 特殊的道具，可用于开启长路鳞迹。

source: A unique item that unlocks Scale of Past when equipped.
target: 特殊的道具，装备后可开启长路鳞迹。

source: A unit of quantified influence used to support your favorite Cube. Only to be used in the Second Coming of Solaris.
target: 数值化的影响力指标，用来应援自己支持的团子，限定在第二索拉内使用。

source: A universal seasoning made from chili, spices, and fats. It can bring unexpected flavors to almost all ingredients.
target: 一种用辣椒、香料、油脂等材料制成的万能调味料。能给几乎所有的食材都带来意想不到的风味。

source: A utiliser pour activer la Chaîne résonatrice de Brant.
target: 用于激活布兰特的共鸣链。

source: A utiliser pour activer la Chaîne résonatrice de Phoebe.
target: 用于激活菲比的共鸣链。

source: A utiliser pour augmenter la Réputation de pêche aux îles Riccioli.
target: 用于提升黎乔利群岛的捕鱼声誉等级。

source: A veces, una roca puede ser más resistente que el metal, sobre todo si está envuelta en cadenas.
target: 有时候，石头会比金属更坚固——特别是上面还缠着锁链的情况下。

source: A vehicle key found in a sealed case at the bottom of Sundermere.
target: 在坠剑湖的封装箱里发现的载具钥匙。

source: A verdadeira sabedoria é sempre acompanhada por uma quantidade igual de tolice.
target: 恰到好处的智慧自有其恰到好处的愚蠢。

source: A verdant edge cut from bamboo, concealed for the way, unsheathed for the cause.
target: 藏锋于竹，谓之道，裁竹为锋，谓之器。

source: A versatile repair kit for all occasions. Whether it's household fixes or professional maintenance, you're sure to find the right tools inside.
target: 常备的万能修理箱，不管是家庭修理还是专业维修，您都一定可以在里面找到适用的工具。

source: A very realistic handmade figurine of Namipon.
target: 手工制作的波仔模型，每个细节都栩栩如生。

source: A viagem chegou ao fim. Seu juramento continua firme e sincero.
target: 故事中的旅途尘埃落定，她的誓言坚定真诚。

source: A viagem chegou ao fim. Seus três desejos agora se realizam.
target: 故事中的旅途尘埃落定，她的三个愿望也已实现。

source: A vibrant fruit platter featuring a variety of fruits. In every city-state of Rinascita, one can always find stalls piled high with fresh fruit along the streets.
target: 包含多种水果的花样果盘。无论在黎那汐塔的哪座城邦，街头总是能看到摆满各种水果的摊位。

source: A vintage bottled in an unusual container. Its resemblance to the rumored Fisalia's elixir earned it this unique name.
target: 使用奇怪容器分装的陈酿，因为形似传闻中翡萨烈家族的秘药，因而获得了这个名字。

source: A vintage from Ragunna, typically crafted from fruits.
target: 来自拉古那地区的陈酿，一般由水果制成。

source: A vintage from Septimont accompanied by mixing tools, ideal for display on a bar counter.
target: 附有调制工具的七丘陈酿，适合放置于吧台上。

source: A vintage from Septimont, known for its bold, robust flavor.
target: 来自七丘地区的陈酿，口味较为浓烈。

source: A vintage portable music player that is quite popular among enthusiasts.
target: 古老的便携式音乐播放器，在爱好者中颇具人气。

source: A vintage worthy of any collection. Its unique aroma and depth of flavor have been meticulously shaped by the passage of time.
target: 足以被称之为收藏品的陈酿，流逝的时间赋予了它们独特的香气与味道。

source: A virtual flag that marks your victories in Peaks of Prestige. It stands as a symbol of fame and unmatched skill.
target: 记载你在”荣耀之丘“中所获胜利的虚拟战旗，象征无上的荣光与名望。

source: A virtual material that imitates standard metal cubes. In real combat scenarios, similar materials can be easily reshaped into various components with a crafting bench.
target: 模仿标准金属铸块建构的虚拟材料。在实战中，使用印造台即可轻松将类似的材料加工成各种工件。

source: A visitor pass for the gate at the market. The image on it depicts a tale from the past about admiration and misunderstanding.
target: 通往广场的大门通行证，上面的图案中记述了一段关于崇拜与误会的往事

source: A vitória coroa os dignos. A Gladiadora Abisselmo oferece sua mais alta saudação à sua força e vontade inabalável.
target: 胜者为王，冥冠角斗家为你非凡的力量、不屈的意志献上最崇高的敬意。

source: A vitória coroa os dignos. A Gladiadora Gelielmo oferece sua mais alta saudação à sua força e vontade inabalável.
target: 胜者为王，凛冠角斗家为你非凡的力量、不屈的意志献上最崇高的敬意。

source: A vitória coroa os dignos. A Gladiadora Trovoelmo oferece sua mais alta saudação à sua força e vontade inabalável.
target: 胜者为王，雷冠角斗家为你非凡的力量、不屈的意志献上最崇高的敬意。

source: A vitória coroa os dignos. O Gladiador Flamelmo oferece a mais alta saudação à sua força e vontade inabalável.
target: 胜者为王，炽冠角斗家为你非凡的力量、不屈的意志献上最崇高的敬意。

source: A vitória coroa os dignos. O Gladiador Luminelmo oferece a mais alta saudação à sua força e vontade inabalável.
target: 胜者为王，耀冠角斗家为你非凡的力量、不屈的意志献上最崇高的敬意。

source: A vitória coroa os dignos. O Gladiador Ventaelmo oferece sua mais alta saudação à sua força e vontade inabalável.
target: 胜者为王，羽冠角斗家为你非凡的力量、不屈的意志献上最崇高的敬意。

source: A voucher for the Weekly Subscription.
target: 周度演算卡的兑换凭证。

source: A voz do mundo

source: A weak kernel structure capable of providing only a limited amount of energy. The Autopuppets it powers are typically restricted to executing the simplest of commands. Commonly found on weak Autopuppets.

source: Através da chuva e da noite, traçando os fios que perpassam todas as coisas, ela rompe o ciclo infinito, abre os braços e abraça um verão que não mais permanece preso na quietude.
target: 于雨幕，于日夜，于横贯万物的弦线间。她斩断循环，张开双臂，接住眼前不再停滞的夏天。

source: Através das fendas, estrondos profundos de ondas distantes ressoam...
target: 从裂隙中，你听见了巨浪翻涌激荡。

source: Através das fendas, estrondos profundos de ondas distantes ressoam...
target: 裂隙中能听见浪涛滚滚……

source: Através das fendas, melodias suaves reverberaram...
target: 裂隙中传出了悠长乐声……

source: Através das fendas, você vislumbrou a cortina carmesim cair e testemunhou o fim da história.
target: 从裂隙中，你看见猩红的帷幕落下，故事迎来了终局。

source: Através das fissuras, ecoam rugidos profundos de ondas distantes...
target: 裂隙中能听见浪涛滚滚……

source: Através desta dança, ele vencerá todos os medos.
target: 以此舞，驱散所有恐惧。

source: Através do tempo congelado, a garota vislumbrou o futuro que havia buscado.
target: 越过停滞的时光，少女窥见了所追寻的未来。

target: 纵然无所事事，但，这也是假期的一种意义。

source: Até mesmo um comerciante que lida com milhões todos os dias ouve música para relaxar. Claro, cabe a você decidir qual é o valor deste toca-música.
target: 即便是日理万金的商人，也会在闲暇时听听音乐放松一下，当然，这个播放器的价值，现在该由你来评估了。

target: 直到月色渐暗

source: Au cœur de la tempête, nous nous rassemblons. La tempête peut faire rage, mais nous sommes nés pour la surmonter.
target: 风暴中集结。风暴不能将我们战胜，因为我们生来就要征服。

source: Au début de chaque vague, 10 % de Modules d'amélioration possédés seront accordés.
target: 每波次开始时，获得当前强化模块储量10%的强化模块。

source: Au milieu des vagues furieuses, nous avançons. Il est juste devant nous.
target: 骇浪下翻腾。它就在我们面前。

source: Au moins, on ne peut pas le vendre à l'infini pour se faire de l'argent dans ce monde.
target: 至少在这里你不能拿它反复换钱。

source: Au plus profond des yeux, un phare inversé. Les marées noires tracent-elles ta silhouette quand tu regardes ?
target: 瞳孔深处，有一座反向的灯塔。当你凝视时，那漆黑的潮汐……是否也在描摹你的轮廓呢？

source: Auch das Nichtstun kann Bedeutung haben. Genau dafür ist ein Urlaub da.
target: 纵然无所事事，但，这也是假期的一种意义。

source: Auch wenn Duellanten nicht wie Gladiatoren kämpfen, eint sie dasselbe Ziel: im Feuer des Gefechts Ruhm und Sieg zu erringen.
target: 即使与真实的角斗大相径庭，决斗家们所追求的终极目标与角斗士们却并无区别——那就是在热烈激斗中取得胜利与荣誉。

source: Auch wenn das Immerfest vorbei ist, entstehen am Ende von „Ewigkeit“ neue Anfänge und Freude ... Erlebe die endlose Freude auf der Lollo-Party!
target: 或许无尽宴会已经走到尽头，但，唯有在无尽的尽头，才能再次衍生无限的可能，无限的欢喜……无限的欢喜，尽在呜呜派对！

source: Auch wenn du es zum ersten Mal probierst, weckt es irgendwie ein Gefühl von Nostalgie.
target: 明明是第一次尝到，却令你感到怀念。

source: Auch wenn es nicht jede Ecke der Nacht erhellen kann, hinterlässt es doch einen flüchtigen Funken am Himmel.
target: 虽不足以照亮黑夜，却能在夜空中留下瞬间的光彩。

source: Aucune fête n'est complète sans musique. Rendez-vous au phonographe du foyer et laissez-vous envoûter par ses mélodies.
target: 无论宴会还是派对，都不能少了音乐。前厅放着旧日的留声机，去听听看有什么美妙的音乐吧。

source: Auf Schwingen des Rhythmus
target: 在活动「沿着节拍启航」限时奖励中获得。

source: Auf dem Balkon im zweiten Stock befindet sich ein Teleskop, mit dem man den Sternenhimmel erblicken kann. (Wird bei Vibe-Stufe 6 freigeschaltet.)
target: 二楼阳台有一台望远镜，据说，是为了看见星空（聚乐值达到阶段6时解锁）。

source: Auf dem Weg der Verbannung singen wir alle zusammen „Pegasus“ um den „Stern“, um uns gegenseitig zu ermutigen und die Freiheit zu preisen. Wo wir frei lachen können, da ist unsere Heimat.
target: 在流放的路途中，大家一起围着“星星”唱《珀伽索斯》，互相打气，歌颂自由。哪里能让大家自由欢笑，哪里就是故乡。

source: Auf den Frühling zu
target: 飞吧，朝向春天

source: Auf den blauen Wassern kräuseln sich sanft die Spiegelbilder von dir und Danjin. Dieser kostbare Augenblick wird euch beiden für immer in Erinnerung bleiben.
target: 碧波荡漾中倒映着你和丹瑾的模样，这一刻，永远停留在彼此的记忆中。

source: Auf der Aussichtsplattform im Garten befindet sich ein Feuerwerkswerfer. Probier ihn aus – vielleicht wartet eine Überraschung auf dich. (Wird nach Abschluss der Quest „Die Antwort liegt dort, wo der Sternenfluss fällt“ freigeschaltet.)
target: 庭园的观景台放着烟花筒，试试看，夜空中会出现惊喜（完成任务「答案在银河倾落之地」后解锁）。

source: Aunque dista mucho de los combates reales en la arena, el objetivo final de los duelistas no es distinto al de los gladiadores: luchar con pasión y alcanzar la victoria y la gloria.

source: Aunque el Festival Eterno ya haya concluido, la felicidad puede llegar a ser «eterno»... ¡Ven y disfruta sin límites en la Fiesta Lollo!
target: 或许无尽宴会已经走到尽头，但，唯有在无尽的尽头，才能再次衍生无限的可能，无限的欢喜……无限的欢喜，尽在呜呜派对！

source: Aunque el deber pesa, ¿quién podría resistirse a asistir a un festival tan magnífico?
target: 即便公务缠身，又怎能放弃一场欢宴？

source: Aunque el destino fatal se cierne sobre nosotros, alzas la llama contra viento y marea, iluminando el camino para las generaciones perdidas que están por venir.
target: 万物归零的死局汹涌而至,你却在逆流中擎起星炬,为迷途的后来者照亮前行的方向。

source: Aunque el fuego me quema la carne, mi espíritu se renueva.
target: 烈火灼我躯壳，灵魂破茧重生。

source: Aunque el tiempo pasa inexorable, la música siempre nos puede devolver a aquellos tiempos.

source: Aunque es una llave de antes del Lamento, parece haber sido poco afectada por el agua de mar debido a su especial artesanía. Parece ser capaz de abrir una puerta a una habitación cercana.

source: Aunque no pueda alcanzar cada rincón nocturno, deja una estela de chispas deslumbrantes en el cielo.

source: Aunque no sea más que la espuma de una ola, brilla con un resplandor imperecedero… Es un regalo de las mareas.

source: Aunque sea la primera vez que lo pruebes, te despertará una sensación de nostalgia.

source: Aunque sea un sueño pasajero, ahí estaré para probar que exististe.

In a world constructed out of energy and syntony, all words and stories can be sung in music.
"I came into this world, bringing naught but paper, rope, and a shadow."
target:

”我来到这个世界上，只带着纸，绳索和身影。“

source: In bernsteinfarbener Zeit verweilen bernsteinfarbene Erinnerungen.
target: 在琥珀色的时光，咽下琥珀色的记忆。

source: In bestimmten „Sportsimulationen“ wurden Zehntausende von Baseballschlägern im In-Game-Shop verkauft, aber kaum Basebälle.

source: In dem Ausstellungsraum wird eine große Auswahl an Waffen präsentiert. Doch vergiss nicht: In einem Land des Friedens dienen sie nur der Ausstellung.

source: In dem Riss breitet sich ein Tacet-Zeichen aus, es pulsiert wie ein pochender Herzschlag …
target: 裂隙中有一枚声痕正在扩张，传出了心跳般的砰砰声……

source: In den Tiefen des Auges steht ein umgedrehter Leuchtturm. Erwidert diese schwarze Flut deine Blicke, wenn du sie anschaust?
target: 瞳孔深处，有一座反向的灯塔。当你凝视时，那漆黑的潮汐……是否也在描摹你的轮廓呢？

source: In den Tiefen des Meeres, wo wandernde Seelen endlos umherirren, hast du immer wieder Krisen verhindert. Unter dem Licht, das du entzündet hast, haben sie endlich ihren Weg nach Hause gefunden.
target: 海墟湍渊中始终有离魂游荡，而你一次次将危机扼杀于起点。在你所点燃的炬火下，他们看清了归家的路。

source: In den Träumen der Seele tanzt du mit allen in den Tiefen.
target: 沉眠于深海的诸多灵魂，与你共生共存。

source: In der Kluft ist der Atem beruhigend...
target: 裂隙中传出的气息让人安心……

source: In der Kluft scheint das Chaos alles zu verschlingen...
target: 裂隙中的混沌似要吞噬一切……

source: In einem silbernem Shuttle treibt ein Reisender über den See des Herzens. Der Traum scheint sich endlos zu erstrecken.

source: In einem sitzt Camellya auf einem Stuhl und scheint mit jemandem in der Nähe zu sprechen.
target: 照片上的椿坐在椅子上，似乎正在对身边的人说着什么。

source:
In einer Welt, die aus Energie und Harmonie geschaffen ist, können alle Wörter und Geschichten in Musik gesungen werden.
"Ich kam in diese Welt, brachte nichts als Papier, Seil und einen Schatten mit."

在能量与谐振构建的世界中，一切言语和故事都可以化为音符。

source: In order to give Pinwen an inexpensive, precious, and inviting gift, Qingru has decided to ask for your help at a hefty price.
target: 为了给品雯送上一份便宜、珍贵、又招人爱的礼物，倾如决定以重金请你帮忙。

source: In the Name of Humanity
target: 献予人间的欢宴

source: In the abyssal dark, you stilled numerous tempests unnamed. Under the beacon you ignited, wandering souls have finally found their way home.
target: 海墟湍渊中始终有离魂游荡，而你一次次将危机扼杀于起点。在你所点燃的炬火下，他们看清了归家的路。

source: In the end, silence reigns. I am the only one who reports to you.
target: 最后是平静。到最后，只有我报信与你。

source: In the face of darkness, shadow, and fear, courage is your sharpest blade.
target: 黑暗、阴影、恐惧，直面它们的勇气即是你最重要的武器。

source: In the heart of the tempest, we gather. The storm may rage, but we were born to prevail.
target: 风暴中集结。风暴不能将我们战胜，因为我们生来就要征服。

source: In the opening act, an obscure youth boarded the ship with nothing but a dagger. In the final act, a notorious pirate captain met his end, betrayed by his own confidant, sinking with a dagger into the deep.
target: 第一幕，岌岌无名的少年带着一把匕首上了船。最终幕，臭名昭著的海盗头子被亲信背刺，和一把匕首一起沉入海底。

source: In the warm mist of the indoor hot spring, behind the fluttering chiffon veils, the laurel-crowned nymph casts her gentle gaze—a signal of invitation to a long-awaited, carefree holiday.
target: 室内温泉热气氤氲，纱帐后、池水中，戴着桂枝的宁芙向你投来柔和的目光——她想邀你一起度过，这来之不易的悠闲假期。

target: 存在异常，如有疑问请联系官方客服

source: The go-to bait for Riccioli fishermen, rich in the shallow seas.
target: 黎那汐塔渔民们常用的鱼饵，富集于浅海，可以在海水中钓鱼。

source: The good news? Your enemies won't see these weapons, so no alarms. The bad news? Neither will you.
target: 好消息是：敌人看不到这些武器，所以敌人并不会对它们产生戒备；坏消息是：你也看不到它们。

source: The greedy souls always complain that the world is not generous enough.
target: 每个贪婪的人都在抱怨世界不够慷慨。

source: The grocer Mahe, who has traveled far and wide, has identified and prepared an ingredient pack according to the recipe. This pack contains all the ingredients needed to make the Jade Treasure Soup.
target: 杂货商人马和走街串巷、见多识广，分辨完配方上记载的名词，他按照配方逐一对照，配好了这样一份食材包，包内含有制作玉珍荟萃汤所需的全部食材。

source: The group photo with your Companions after watching "The Tale of Demon-Banishing Asura" together.
target: 和伙伴们一起欣赏英雄戏《修罗除祟传》后拍摄的纪念合影。

source: The highest honor bestowed by the Academy to the participants in the Glacier Science Research Initiative. For Zhizhi, these were the last words her father left her.
target: 由研究院授予冰原科考行动参与者的至高荣誉。对知枝来说，这就是父亲留给她的最后的话语。

source: The impossible wish responded to her in another form.
target: 无法实现的愿望，以另一种形式向她回应。

source: The information touchpad of Sizhe, returning it may have a reward.
target: 属于思哲的信息触板，归还也许有奖励。

source: The instruction manual for synthesizing a Sonar Circuit. Use to master the synthesis of Sonar Circuit.
target: 合成寻音元件的指导配方，使用后会习得寻音元件合成方法。

source: The instruction manual for synthesizing a Waypoint Module. Use to master the synthesis of Waypoint Module.
target: 合成标芯模块的指导配方，使用后会习得标芯模块合成方法。

source: The jade pendant is clear and pure, reflecting the heart of its owner.
target: 玉佩清正澄澈，恰如持有者的内心。

source: The journey has come to an end. Her oath remains steadfast and sincere.
target: 故事中的旅途尘埃落定，她的誓言坚定真诚。

source: The journey has come to an end. Her three wishes have now all come true.
target: 故事中的旅途尘埃落定，她的三个愿望也已实现。

source: The key dropped by Blobfly.
target: 飞猎手掉落的钥匙。

source: The lantern is entombed in frost, as if a piece of history had been buried within. Someone cradled it, sinking into a deep slumber until the first breath of spring.
target: 提灯上覆盖着厚厚的白霜，大抵是一段历史被尘封其中。有人怀抱着它，在春日到来以前陷入深长睡眠。

source: The lantern-shaped Terminal used by Resonators from the Land of Echoes. Originally a gift from Sentinel Imperator to the people of Rinascita, it has since become their guiding light.
target: 「声骸之国」黎那汐塔的共鸣者所使用的终端，形如提灯。它源于岁主英白拉多的馈赠，而后，成为陪伴在黎那汐塔人漫长求索之路上的一点明光。

source: The last commemorative item earned from restoring the Plushie Village.
target: 修复布偶村期间的最终纪念。

source: The leaf with a completely crystallized surface.
target: 表面完全晶石化的叶片。

source: The ledger of Lyu Yi, recording his day-to-day expenses.
target: 店长吕一的账本，记载了他日常的支出。

source: The left plate, blanketed in dust. The right, scabbed. Your Honor, please place your weight.
target: 左盘落灰，右盘结痂。审判官，请放入你的砝码。

source: The legendary first-ever game cartridge for the first-ever video game console. Revered by enthusiasts as a sacred relic.
target: 传说中那款开山之作的初版卡带，爱好者将其视若圭臬。

source: The legendary game console that ushered in the dawn of a new era in video gaming. Revered by enthusiasts as a sacred relic.
target: 传说中那款开山之作的初版游戏机，爱好者将其视若圭臬。

source: The lingering frequencies on the bracelet can help trace more of this Bloom Bearer's forgotten belongings.
target: 可使用手链上残留的频率，去定位这名执花更多的遗留物所在位置。

source: The living dwell upon the dark beyond, stubbornly denying the insurmountable divide between life and death.
target: 生者执念于黑沉沉的夜之彼岸，仍不相信生与死之间那不可逾越的距离。

source: The lost weapon
target: 遗落的武器

source: The lost weapon.
target: 遗落的武器。

source: The main source of sweetness, often associated with a sense of happiness.
target: 甜味的主要来源，常常被人与幸福感联系在一起。

source: The medal lost by Zhi Zhi.
target: 知枝遗落的勋章。

source: The memories we made together will be carried far into the future.
target: 那些一起的记忆，会延伸向遥远的未来。

source: The metal scrolls with mysterious symbols seem to be able to create some kind of connection with Rover.
target: 记载着神秘符号的金属卷轴，似乎与漂泊者能产生某种联系。

source: The moon has long been shattered by the Waveworn Phenomenon. What we observe is nothing but the past's mirage.
target: 那月轮早已在海蚀中破碎，我们观测到的不过是过去的幻影。

source: The more comprehensive data gathered across different simulation intensities become, the more Resonator allocation for future Waveworn Phenomenon encounters will improve.
target: 不同强度的对战演习数据收集得越全面，未来应对海蚀现象、分派各等级人员时将会更合理。

source: The more data is collected from the drills, the more accurate the Waveworn Phenomena simulations become.
target: 演习数据收集得越全面，未来对于海蚀现象的推演将会越精确。

source: The most common bait in Rinascita. Casting it with Baiting creates an ideal Fishing Spot.
target: 黎那汐塔最常见的鱼饵，通过「抛饵」技能释放该鱼饵后，可以生成一个优质的捕捞点。

source: The mysterious special ornament prepared by Namipon.
target: 波仔准备的神秘开业装饰

source: The nest of Leafweaver, a kind of chirping insect. Meticulously structured, it is primarily built from leaves and petals.
target: 鸣虫“叶中匠”的巢穴，多由树叶和花瓣筑成，结构精巧。

source: The night was far too long, so long that even the end of the endless dark was nowhere to be found. Holding tight to the final spark of light in her arms, in her haze, she mistook it for the breaking dawn.
target: 这一晚实在太长，长到看不到漫漫长夜尽头在何方。她拥着怀里仅存的光亮，恍惚间将它认作了破晓的光。

source: The nighttime background music of Avinoleum Theological Seminary. Obtain the Melody Box for this song from the Musicfly in Tower of Ascension, Avinoleum Theological Seminary.
target: 阿维纽林神学院的夜间背景音乐，在阿维纽林神学院·向上之塔的音乐飞萤处获得该乐曲的鸣奏之匣。

source: The novel excerpt stored in the information device.
target: 储存在信息装置中的小说选段。

source:
The old currency issued by Averardo Bank, which is no longer in circulation in Ragunna.
Nowadays, it is good for nothing but commemoration. Averardo Bank is working to recycle these antiques.
target:
拉古那不再流通的旧币「莫内」，由埃弗拉德银行发行。
现今，「莫内」的纪念价值已远大于使用价值，埃弗拉德银行正着手回收。

source: The original flavor of Namipon's Sparkling Water that can be found everywhere in Honami. Loved by both elders and children.
target: 原味的波子汽水，在穗波随处可见。老人孩子都爱喝。

source: The original manuscript stored in the information device.
target: 储存在信息装置中的原稿。

source: The painting captures the Blessed Maiden's contemplation in the Seminary. Though it has weathered the passage of time, her sacred aura remains undimmed.
target: 画作上刻画着昔日圣女在神学院里凝神沉思的场景，即使时光流逝，这份圣洁也未曾改变。

source: The past cannot be changed; the future has yet to come.
target: 过去无从改变，未来尚未到来。

source: The peach blossom's beauty longs for eyes that see.
target: 桃之夭夭，灼灼其华。

source:
The perfect morning sandwich—delicious, quick, and wholesome.
Even the simplest bread holds infinite potential. Like life, a panini may seem the same every day, but it is always a little different.
target:
每天早上必吃的三明治，美味、便利、健康。
就算是普通的面包也能融合无限创意。帕尼尼就像生活，日日都相似，每每都不同。

source: The photo that Duzhou always carries. In it are three people in Xuanfang Warden garb, laughing and embracing each other. At the bottom are written their names: Duzhou, Yanlang, and Mingyu.
target: 渡舟总是随身携带的照片，照片上是三个身着定玄卫的衣装、相拥而笑的人。下方写着他们的名字：渡舟，颜朗，明煜。

source: The portable music player model used by the protagonist of a well-known work.
target: 某知名作品中主角的同款随身音乐播放器。

source: The power that once carried someone through the mountains will remain in the mountains, remain on someone.
target: 那些电能曾经载着谁人走遍群山，此后也会留在山中，留在谁身上。

source: The precious experimental records brought back from the Tower of Adversity can be exchanged for various rewards in the Adversity Exchange.
target: 从逆境深塔中带回的珍贵实验记录，可在深塔兑换所中兑换各种奖励。

source: The precious remnants of the civilization reverberate within... Perhaps they hold infinite possibilities.
target: 文明的珍稀余音在其中流转……也许它能带来无限的可能。

source: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past.
target: 声之领域崩解、坍缩后的产物，遍布在世界的各个角落，记录着未失实的过去。

source: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past. The Plushies are collecting them—perhaps they'll have something in exchange.
target:
声之领域崩解、坍缩后的产物，遍布在世界的各个角落，记录着未失实的过去。
布偶们似乎对这种声匣很感兴趣，或许可以换得一些好东西。

source: The product of processed rice, rich in carbohydrates, is one of the most important staple food sources in the world.
target: 稻谷经加工后所产出的成品，富含碳水化合物，是世界上最重要的主食来源之一。

source: The raw material of a beverage that once swept the world, rich in a variety of nutritious substances.
target: 曾风靡整个世界的饮品原料，富含多种有益物质。

source: The reality tells you that the creature this specimen is made from does not exist. But in your dreams, you have clearly seen it and received its words of wisdom. It has given you such power to let you realize dreams are also a form of reality.
target: 现实告诉你，这份标本来自的生物并不存在。但在梦境中，你分明见过它，它给予你忠告，赠与你强大的力量，告诉你梦境亦是一种现实。

source: The redemption voucher for the Lunite Subscription.
target: 月相观测卡的兑换凭证。

source: The rich, roasted aroma of coffee blends with a gentle hint of milk, creating a smooth, layered flavor in every sip. On every morning in Solaris, take this with you, and say "good morning" to yourself and to the world.
target: 焦香咖啡与淡淡奶香相互叠加、碰撞，让你每一口都能感受到丝滑。索拉里斯的每一个清晨，请你带上它，向自己、向他人说一声——早安！

source:
The ripples of the waves converge into the branches of hope.
"That is the proof of your encounter."
target:
波纹的涟漪汇聚成了希望的枝桠。
“那是你们相遇的证明。”

source:
The ripples of the waves converge into the sprouts of desire.
"That is the echo of your call."
target:
波纹的涟漪汇聚成了渴望的新芽。
“那是你呼唤的余音。”

source: The rock shell covering the arm of Feilian Beringal, named for the thunderous roar of Feilian's heavy punch.
target: 覆盖在飞廉之猩臂膊上的岩壳，因飞廉的重拳挥落之际的千钧呼啸而得名。

source: The rule is simple: the more fish you catch, the more experience you gain as a fisherman, and the more Fame you earn. Just remember, fish are never meant to be worn as medals on your chest.
target: 道理很简单，捕到的鱼越多，作为捕鱼人的经验也就越多，声誉也就越多——请注意，不要把鱼当做勋章挂在胸前。

source: The scenic photo near the camp of the Ninth Investigation Corps of the Central Plains.
target: 中曲台地第九调查兵团营地附近的风景照。

source: The screen set up by Lollo Logistics and Startorch Academy occasionally remind you of matters beyond the party.
target: 呜呜物流和星炬学院架设的屏幕，偶尔让你想起派对之外的事。

source: The seatides swell to embrace you, in your triumphant return from the beyond.
target: 你身披海潮，自彼岸归来。

source: The second piece of background music played while confronting Dragon of Dirge. The Melody Box of this track is obtained from the Supply Chest on the chandelier in the Echo Depository of Averardo Vault.
target: 与叹息古龙对决时的背景音乐其二，在埃弗拉德金库的声骸藏馆吊灯上的奇藏中获得该乐曲的鸣奏之匣。

source: The seed of the Cloudperch Tree. Its opposing bracts spread open widely, resembling a pair of wings resting upon a branch.
target: 风栖桐的种子，其苞片对生舒展，犹如栖停在枝头的一对羽翼。

source: The singing section of the Song of the Empty Dawn
target: 空晓之歌的唱段

source: The song performed during the anniversary ceremony.
target: 在周年庆典中奏响的歌。

source: The sound material made from suspicious audio which appeared in the Blazing Prairie.
target: 《烈火燎原》中出现的可疑音频制成的声料。

source: The sound material of the Song of the Empty Dawn sung by Qianxin.
target: 由千歆演唱的空晓之歌制成的声料。

source: The sound material that can reproduce the scene after use.
target: 使用后可复现画面的声料。

source: The sound materials of the Song of the Empty Dawn performed by Qian Xin.
target: 由千歆演唱的空晓之歌制成的声料。

source: The sound of the fountain seems to rhyme with the laughter of the people.
target: 喷泉的水声，仿佛回应人们的笑语。

source: The sound of the tide meets the shifting light, like a distant call echoing slowly between sea and stars.
target: 潮声与光影交织，仿佛远方的呼唤，在海与星之间缓缓回荡。

source: The spark in the rift will eventually ignite a blaze...
target: 裂隙中的星火终将燎原……

source: The special supply chest obtained from Shilang in the Tiger's Maw.
target: 从虎口山脉的石琅处获得的特殊补给箱。

source: The special supply pack issued by the Store. It is delivered to the customer by Lollo Logistics.
target: 商城为客户发放的特供补给包，由呜呜物流送达至客户手中。

source: The special supply pack issued by the Store. It is delivered to the customer by Lollo Logistics. Open to claim rich supplies.
target: 商城为客户发放的特供补给箱，由呜呜物流送达至客户手中，领取后可获得丰厚的补给。

source: The standee Namipon made to celebrate the opening day according to your suggestions. It shows a mysterious, stylish, and adorable girl.
target: 根据你的建议，波仔所制作的开业纪念立牌，上面描绘了一位神秘、帅气、可爱的少女。

source: The stars shall crown you.
target: 群星将为您加冕。

source:
The student ID Chisa unintentionally took amid the Void Storm.
The ID is eroded, but you can still make out your face in the picture.
Twenty-odd years ago, you once roamed the halls of Startorch Academy.
target:
千咲被卷入虚质磁暴时无意中拿到的学生证。学生证表面遍布着侵蚀痕迹，头像处隐约显露出了你的脸庞。
二十多年前，你曾在星炬学院留下足迹。

source: The supplies prepared for the Moonlit Fair must be meticulously planned and allocated to ensure they fulfill as many wishes as possible.
target: 为宵月会所准备的物资需要进行周密的规划和分配，以保证它们被用来满足尽可能多的愿望。

source: The swaying swing echoes to the vicissitude of long lost years.
target: 摇曳的秋千，呼唤着海海的千秋。

source: The talisman of that child.
target: 那孩子的护身符

source: The tenth anniversary collector's edition of "Stone Leaf Tears".
target: 话本《石叶泪》十周年典藏版。

source: The tenth anniversary collector's edition of the storybook "Stone Leaf Tear".
target: 话本《石叶泪》十周年典藏版。

source: The thorns of the wildflowers had encased the glass, and creeping vines traced the curve of her hand. The girl watched for a long time, and finally reached toward the flame beneath the greenery.
target: 野花的刺已包裹玻璃外壳，藤蔓缠绕勾勒手中的弧度。少女观察良久，终于还是将手伸向绿植之下的火光。

source: The tides murmur, summer lingers. Stay with this easy, quiet moment.
target: 潮声悠悠，夏日漫漫，享受当下闲适的一刻吧。

source: The time we spend on stage makes our wishes shine brighter.
target: 彼此的时光在舞台上交汇，照亮春日的祈愿。

source: The traveler's footprints will forever remain among the Thousand Isles.
target: 旅者航行的轨迹将长存于千岛之间。

source:
The umbrella from urban legends, said to be somehow linked to several misadventures.
A rumor later debunked by Namipon.
target:
都市传说中的雨伞，曾被指控与多起意外事故有关。
经波仔查证系谣传。

source: The universal currency issued by Huanglong, officially recognized across many regions.
target: 由瑝珑发行，被各大地区的官方认可的通用货币。

source: The universal currency of Solaris-3.
target: 索拉里斯的通用货币。

source: The universal currency of the Sonoro Cosmos. Can be exchanged for supplies and rewards at the Stardock Market.
target: 索诺拉宇宙中的通用货币，能够在星港集市换取物资和奖励。

target: 寻音声呐在今州及周边区域的使用许可证明。为确保今州及周边区域频率安全，请使用者持有此官方证明后，在已授权区域合规使用寻音声呐。

target: 寻音声呐在黎那汐塔及周边区域的使用许可证明。为确保黎那汐塔及周边区域频率安全，请使用者持有此官方证明后，在已授权区域合规使用寻音声呐。

target: 奇藏测探仪在今州及周边区域的使用许可证明。为确保今州及周边区域频率安全，请使用者持有此官方证明后，在已授权区域合规使用奇藏测探仪。

source: The use permit of the Lootmapper in Mengzhou. To ensure frequency safety in Mengzhou, users are permitted to use the Lootmapper only within authorized areas in compliance with this official permit.
target: 奇藏测探仪在梦州及周边区域的使用许可证明。为确保梦州及周边区域频率安全，请使用者持有此官方证明后，在已授权区域合规使用奇藏测探仪。

source: The use permit of the Lootmapper in Rinascita. To ensure frequency safety in Rinascita, users are permitted to use the Lootmapper only within authorized areas in compliance with this official permit.
target: 奇藏测探仪在黎那汐塔及周边区域的使用许可证明。为确保黎那汐塔及周边区域频率安全，请使用者持有此官方证明后，在已授权区域合规使用奇藏测探仪。

source: The very paints Lynae used to bring her miniature models to life. Lynae loves to fill her spare time with unusual hobbies, and painting miniatures is one of many results of those creative endeavors.
target: 琳奈涂装微缩模型时使用的颜料套装。她总是会尝试用各种各样奇奇怪怪的爱好塞满自己的课余时间，涂装各种各样的模型也是这些尝试的成果之一。

source: The voucher used to participate in the Lollo Genie special lottery.
target: 进行「呜呜精灵」特别企划抽奖的核销凭证。

source: The voucher used to redeem the Lollo Helper special delivery.
target: 兑换「助呜为乐」特别邮递的核销凭证。

source: The weapons targeted by the Boar Gang. The original owner seems to be no longer important.
target: 被猪婆帮盯上的武器，原主人是谁似乎已经不重要了。

source: The years fall away as blossoms do. She is still here, watching over the peaceful dreams of others.
target: 任岁岁年年如花落去，她仍在这里，守望着人们安稳的梦。

source: The yellow ore obtained after removing the Tacetite shell is shaped like Tacetreite, but is actually still Tacetite, and is usually used by the Exile Leaders.
target: 去掉黑石外壳后获得的黄色矿石，形似潮石，但实际上还是黑石，通常被流放者首领使用。

source: Un merveilleux vieux bouillon à l'arôme parfumé qui fait ressortir les saveurs cachées des plats de viande.

target: 记录了一位命途多舛的女性一生之痛的信息。

source: Un message étrange
target: 《奇怪的通讯》

source: Un metal con forma de bala, llamado «Combustor» por su forma peculiar. Requiere de procesos de purificación especializados, ya que generalmente contiene un alto nivel de impurezas.
target: 形似枪弹的金属，因其奇妙的形态，被冠以聚燃体之名。通常其杂质含量都偏高，需要进行专门的提纯处理。

source: Un millésime de Ragunna, généralement élaboré à partir de fruits.
target: 来自拉古那地区的陈酿，一般由水果制成。

source: Un millésime de Septimont accompagné d'outils de mélange, idéal pour être exposé sur un comptoir de bar.

source: Un millésime de Septimont, connu pour sa saveur audacieuse et robuste.
target: 来自七丘地区的陈酿，口味较为浓烈。

source: Un millésime digne de toute collection. Son arôme unique et sa saveur profonde ont été méticuleusement façonnés par le passage du temps.

source: Un millésime embouteillé dans un récipient inhabituel. Sa ressemblance avec le prétendu élixir de Fisalia lui a valu ce nom unique.
target: 使用奇怪容器分装的陈酿，因为形似传闻中翡萨烈家族的秘药，因而获得了这个名字。

source: Un minerai renfermant un éclat de lumière. À utiliser dans l'événement « Révélation lunaire » pour déchiffrer les phases de la lune.

source: Un minerai ressemblant à l'écaille de la Sentinelle. Peut servir à réparer les armes.
target: 形似岁主鳞片的矿石，可用于修缮武器。

source: Un mineral ampliamente distribuido, cuyo único color púrpura profundo es altamente reconocible. Debido a su textura frágil, este mineral tiene requisitos muy altos para el equipo de procesamiento.
target: 分布广泛的矿物，那独一无二的深邃紫色却极具辨识度。因为质地易碎，这种矿物对于加工设备的要求也非常高。

source: Un mineral cuyo interior emite un brillo. Puede usarse en el evento «Revelación lunar» para descifrar las fases lunares.
target: 贮藏了一束流光的矿石，可凭此在活动「月华解明」中进行月相解读。

source: Un mineral distintivo en forma de un racimo de agujas, agudo y duro en textura. Las creaciones hechas de Escarlasta a menudo se utilizan para cortar metal y otros cristales, o para la producción de armas.
target: 针簇状的特色矿物，质地锋利而坚硬。红针晶簇的造物常用于切割金属与其它晶体，或用作武器的生产。

source: Un minéral distinctif en forme de grappe d'aiguilles, tranchant et dur en texture. Les créations des cristaux rouges sont souvent utilisées pour couper le métal et d'autres cristaux, ou pour la production d'armes.
target: 针簇状的特色矿物，质地锋利而坚硬。红针晶簇的造物常用于切割金属与其它晶体，或用作武器的生产。

source: Un miroir brisé qui réfléchit l'ombre du Chat blanc. Mais quel côté du miroir révèle la vérité ? Quel côté n'est qu'illusion ? C'est comme un rêve.
target: 一块残缺的镜片，倒映着白猫的影子，镜片的两面究竟谁是真，谁是假？就如同踏入梦境一般。
